encoder: 4 Sonnet 5.5 agents (claude-sonnet-5-5), a keel and three parts working in parallel from per-agent briefs, merged by a lead agent; each part read by an independent Opus test author
display_name: Employment Act 1968 (Singapore) and Employment (Retrenchment Reporting) Notification 2019: layer-1 modules and individual seats
maintainer: undetermined: to be set when the row is deposited
edition: Employment Act 1968, 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation, version in force from 5/12/2025, as converted to plain text (EmA1968.txt), and the Employment (Retrenchment Reporting) Notification 2019 (S 200/2019, EmA1968-S200-2019.txt)
seat: an employee working in Singapore (or about to start), asking on facts they can state whether the Act covers them, what they are owed, when, and what they can do if it is not given

scope.encoded: every range of the text, by agent: keel lines 1 to 784, ea1 785 to 2596, ea2 2597 to 4611 and the Notification, ea3 4612 to 6790; each part's coverage table is in notes/<agent>-NOTES.md
scope.inputs_not_encoded: figures, orders and other Acts the text leaves outside it, taken as inputs

not_reviewed: No lawyer or other domain expert has read this encoding against the text, and it has not been checked against the official text. The text it quotes is a converter's rendering. The readings the parts flag for a lawyer (notes/<part>-NOTES.md) are not ruled beyond Meng's four rulings recorded in NOTES.md.
